edits.after: His R (Death From Below) execute threatens every trade you take from level 6 on, and Karma gains no new ult to answer it.

edits.before: First item: RQ chunks and RE engages — convert to plates and picks now.
edits.after: Pyke's first-item lethality plus roam pressure outpaces your first-item spike; his gank threat keeps map pressure his.

edits.before: Late Karma enables: RE the engage, tether the diver, RQ the sieges.
edits.after: Karma's low base HP still sits inside Q-hook-and-R-execute range even with items, so Pyke stays the more dangerous support in skirmishes.

edits.before: The tether breaks if YOU leave — hold the ground or don't throw it.
